Strong national record: every act e-Sbírka consolidates (18,582 acts since 1918, 8,967 in force on main) with dated in-force history, and the Constitution, Civil Code, Criminal Code and both procedure codes are held as the current consolidated texts (Civil Code 89/2012 with 2025 amendments in force 2026-01-01), all three spot checks matching. No case law is held, and the freshness monitor marks the corpus 'stale' although its record runs to 2026-11-08.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
